author: 小小单词卡
attribution: PET 口袋绘本系列原创短篇 · 第二篇
intro: 二号站台的水洼里漂来一只纸船。梅捞起来一看，有个人恐怕要赶不上车了。

chapters.title: 站台上的纸船
chapters.en: May waited at the [[station]]. A paper [[boat]] sailed across [[platform]] two and bumped her shoe. She bent down and got her sleeves [[wet]].
chapters.zh: 梅在车站等车。一只纸船漂过二号站台，碰了碰她的鞋。她弯下腰，弄湿了袖口。

chapters.title: 船底藏着什么？
chapters.en: May unfolded the paper. It was a [[ticket]]! The [[fare]] was for a child travelling to Little Bay [[Harbour]]. In the corner was a [[drawing]] of a whale.
chapters.zh: 梅把纸展开。原来是张车票！票上写的是去小湾港的儿童票价。角落里画着一只鲸鱼。

chapters.title: 三号站台
chapters.en: An [[announcement]] came over the loudspeaker. “Sorry for the [[delay]]. The [[train]] to Little Bay will leave from platform three.” May ran up the [[bridge]] to look for the owner.
chapters.zh: 广播响了。“很抱歉列车晚点。开往小湾的火车将从三号站台发车。”梅跑上天桥，寻找车票的主人。

chapters.title: 没有尾巴的鲸鱼
chapters.en: A young [[passenger]] stood beside a [[suitcase]]. His father looked [[confused]]. May put one [[finger]] over the whale. “What was on your ticket?” “A whale with no tail!”
chapters.zh: 一个小乘客站在行李箱旁。他爸爸一脸困惑。梅用一根手指盖住鲸鱼。“你车票上画的是什么？”“一条没尾巴的鲸鱼！”

chapters.title: 船长上车了
chapters.en: “There was no room for a tail under the [[price]]!” May gave him the ticket. He took a seat by the [[window]]. “Will you [[fold]] it again, [[Captain]]?” “Today my boat is taking the train!”
chapters.zh: “标价下面没地方画尾巴了！”梅把车票还给他。他在窗边坐下。“船长，你还要把它折起来吗？”“今天我的船要坐火车啦！”

album.en: At the [[station]], May and her [[neighbour]] waited on [[platform]] two. A paper [[boat]] bumped her shoe. She fished it out of a puddle and got her sleeves [[wet]].
album.zh: 梅和邻居在车站的二号站台等车。一只纸船碰了碰她的鞋。她伸手把船从水洼里捞出来，袖口也湿了。

album.en: [[Curious]], May opened up the [[boat]]. It was a [[ticket]]! Someone had paid a child's [[fare]] to Little Bay. In one corner was a tiny [[drawing]]. May smiled.
album.zh: 梅觉得好奇，就把纸船展开了。原来是张车票！去小湾镇的，买的是儿童票。票角上还有一幅小画。梅看了直笑。

album.en: “Sorry for the [[delay]],” came an [[announcement]]. “The [[train]] to Little Bay [[Harbour]] will now leave from [[platform]] three.” Off went the crowd. May took the little [[ticket]] with her.
album.zh: “列车晚点了，很抱歉。”站内广播响起来，“开往小湾港的列车改在三号站台发车。”人群动了起来。梅带上那张小车票，跟了过去。

album.en: From the [[bridge]], May spotted a small [[passenger]] beside a [[suitcase]]. He was turning his [[pocket]] inside out. His dad looked [[confused]]. “But how can a [[ticket]] sail away?”
album.zh: 梅从天桥上望下去，看见一个小乘客站在行李箱旁，把口袋都翻了出来。他爸爸一脸困惑。“可车票怎么会漂走呢？”

album.en: May hurried down. She put her [[finger]] over the [[drawing]]. “What's on your [[ticket]]?” “A whale with no tail! There wasn't room under the [[price]].” May lifted her [[finger]]. Exactly!
album.zh: 梅赶紧跑下桥，用手指盖住那幅画。“你的票上画着什么？”“一条没尾巴的鲸鱼！价钱底下那点地方，画不下了。”梅抬起手指。还真是！

album.en: May gave it back. The boy took a seat by the [[window]]. “Going to [[fold]] it again, [[Captain]]?” May called. He slipped it into his [[pocket]]. “Today my [[boat]]'s taking the [[train]]!”
album.zh: 梅把票还给他。男孩上车，坐到了窗边。“船长，还要把它折起来吗？”梅喊道。男孩把票揣进口袋。“今天，我的船坐火车！”
